note: Canonical status source. Every count here is verified by a command or file listed in scripts/check-status.mjs, which CI runs on every push/PR. Update this file (and the docs it guards) whenever a verified count changes — never edit the docs' numbers without updating this file first. Schema convention: `commit` fields are current-state "last verified at" pointers — each records the commit at which the recorded numbers were last verified, and moves forward when the battery re-runs at a newer commit; previous values are preserved in this file's git history. Narrative fields (e.g. security.auditFindings.status) are historical records of when findings were closed or defects fixed and are never rewritten. Structure (since the 2026-11-22 reconciliation): `canonical` is the current main state; `evidence` separates the latest verified test commit, the latest verified security scan commit, the real-model evaluation state (NONE has ever run — hasRun false, no commit), and historical evaluation evidence; `pendingValidations` lists what still needs verifying.
